deficits.evidence: No footway present, pedestrians must walk in the roadway
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Informal path partly blocked by obstructions
deficits.suggestion: Remove obstructions and create a clear, usable informal path or upgrade to a formal sidewalk on the right side.

deficits.evidence: Uneven sections on the informal path
deficits.suggestion: Repair and level the informal path to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: No crossing facility despite pedestrian demand
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Insufficient street lighting in an urban area
deficits.suggestion: Install additional street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for both drivers and pedestrians.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a formal footway, and building one is a standard feasible improvement.
The right side has an informal path obstructed by parked cars and debris.
The unpaved right shoulder shows uneven surfaces and dirt.
No marked crossings are visible on this stretch of road.
The images are taken during daylight, making it impossible to determine the adequacy of street lighting.
